conditions.name: Ablaze
conditions.description: You are on fire and take damage each round until the flames are put out.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: An open wound drains you, costing Wounds each round until staunched.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: You cannot see, failing tests that rely on sight and fighting at a penalty.

conditions.name: Broken
conditions.description: Your nerve has failed; you flee or cower and cannot take aggressive actions.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: You cannot hear, failing tests that rely on sound.

conditions.name: Entangled
conditions.description: You are caught or grappled and cannot move until you break free.

conditions.name: Fatigued
conditions.description: You are tired, suffering a penalty to all tests until you rest.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: A toxin courses through you, costing Wounds each round until it passes.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: You are knocked down and must spend an action to stand.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: You are dazed and reeling, suffering a penalty and unable to act effectively.

conditions.name: Surprised
conditions.description: You were caught off guard and cannot react until the surprise passes.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: You are knocked out and helpless until you recover your senses.

criticals.name: Bruised Muscle
criticals.effect: Painful throb. −10 to tests using the struck location for 1 round.

criticals.name: Deep Cut
criticals.effect: A clean wound. Bleeding 1; a cosmetic scar remains.

criticals.name: Concussion
criticals.effect: Ringing skull. Stunned 1 and −10 to mental tests until healed.

criticals.name: Broken Nose
criticals.effect: Eyes water uncontrollably. −10 to sight-based Perception until healed.

criticals.name: Fractured Bone
criticals.effect: A grinding crack. −10 to all tests using the struck location until set.

criticals.name: Dislocated Shoulder
criticals.effect: The arm hangs useless until reset; no two-handed weapons.

criticals.name: Cracked Ribs
criticals.effect: Every breath stabs. −10 to Strength- and Agility-based tests.

criticals.name: Torn Tendon
criticals.effect: Movement halved whenever the struck location is used.

criticals.name: Smashed Knee
criticals.effect: The leg buckles. Movement halved; Prone on any hard move.

criticals.name: Mangled Hand
criticals.effect: Fingers crushed. −20 to tests needing that hand's grip.

criticals.name: Severed Finger
criticals.effect: Gone for good. −10 to fine Dexterity work until tended.

criticals.name: Severed Artery
criticals.effect: Blood sheets out. Bleeding 2 until staunched, then Bleeding 1.

criticals.name: Ruptured Organ
criticals.effect: Internal bleeding. Bleeding 1 and −10 to all tests until treated.

criticals.name: Shattered Leg
criticals.effect: The bone is splintered. Cannot run; Movement quartered until set.

criticals.name: Punctured Lung
criticals.effect: Wheezing agony. Fatigued 1 that rest cannot remove until healed.

criticals.name: Gouged Eye
criticals.effect: Sight lost on one side. −20 to ranged attacks and sight Perception.

criticals.name: Skull Fracture
criticals.effect: A caved-in crack. Unconscious now; −10 to all tests for weeks.

criticals.name: Lost Limb
criticals.effect: The struck limb is severed. Bleeding 3; the loss is permanent.

notes.title: Sin thresholds and penalties
notes.body: Sin 1 → −10 Faith. Sin 3 → harder spellcasting. Sin 5 → punitive event.

notes.body: WP test; on failure the Broken condition.
